tools.name: google_list_files
tools.description: List files and subfolders in the configured Google Drive project folder or one of its descendant folders. Sharing and permission settings cannot be changed by agents.

parent_id.description: Optional Google Drive folder ID. It must be the configured root folder or a descendant. Omit to list the project root folder.

page_size.description: Maximum number of files to return, from 1 to 100.

tools.name: google_search_files
tools.description: Search file and folder names recursively within the configured Google Drive project folder.

query.description: Text contained in the file or folder name.

mime_type.description: Optional exact Google Drive MIME type filter.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results, from 1 to 100.

tools.name: google_read_file
tools.description: Read the content of a non-folder file inside the configured Google Drive project folder. Google Docs are returned as structured text; binary files are returned as bounded base64 content.

file_id.description: Google Drive file ID inside the configured project folder.

tools.name: google_read_document
tools.description: Read the text and current revision of a Google Docs document inside the configured project folder.

file_id.description: Google Drive file ID of a Google Docs document inside the configured project folder.

tools.name: google_create_folder
tools.description: Create a subfolder inside the configured Google Drive project folder or one of its descendant folders.

parent_id.description: Optional descendant folder ID. Omit to create the folder in the project root.

tools.name: google_create_document
tools.description: Create a Google Docs document inside the configured Google Drive project folder or a descendant folder.

name.description: Name of the new Google Docs document.

parent_id.description: Optional descendant folder ID. Omit to create the document in the project root.

initial_text.description: Optional initial text to insert into the new document.

tools.name: google_create_document_from_template
tools.description: Copy a Google Docs template that is inside the configured project folder into the project folder or a descendant folder.

template_file_id.description: Google Drive file ID of a Google Docs template inside the configured project folder.

parent_id.description: Optional descendant folder ID. Omit to create the document in the project root.

tools.name: google_update_document
tools.description: Apply Google Docs batch update operations to a document inside the configured project folder. Provide the revision ID from google_read_document to reject stale edits.

file_id.description: Google Drive file ID of the document to update.

requests.description: One or more Google Docs API request objects, each containing exactly one operation.

required_revision_id.description: Prefer the short revision_token (r-...) returned by google_read_document; the full revision_id is also accepted. The update is rejected if the document changed since it was read.

tools.name: google_move_file
tools.description: Move a file or subfolder to another folder inside the configured Google Drive project folder. It cannot move anything outside the project folder.

file_id.description: Google Drive file or folder ID to move.

parent_id.description: Destination folder ID inside the configured project folder.

tools.name: google_delete_file
tools.description: Delete a file or descendant subfolder inside the configured Google Drive project folder. The root folder cannot be deleted. Sharing and permission settings are not changed.

file_id.description: Google Drive file or descendant folder ID to delete.

tools.name: google_export_file
tools.description: Export a Google Docs document inside the configured project folder as base64-encoded content, for example DOCX or PDF.

file_id.description: Google Drive file ID of the document to export.

mime_type.description: Export MIME type. Defaults to DOCX.

tools.name: google_append_table_row
tools.description: Append a row to a table inside a Google Docs document. The tool finds the table by its header cells, computes all structural indices, optionally deduplicates, and verifies the result. The agent provides only cell values; the tool handles all Docs API index calculations.

file_id.description: Google Drive file ID of the Google Docs document.

table_selector.description: Selector to identify the target table.

header_cells.description: Ordered list of column header texts to match the table's first row.

cells.description: Cell values for the new row, one per column, in column order.

dedup.description: Optional deduplication. When set, the tool checks whether a row with the same value already exists before writing.

column_index.description: Zero-based column index to compare. Default 0.

match.description: Match mode: 'date' normalises dd/mm/yyyy before comparing, 'exact' compares trimmed text literally, 'none' disables dedup.

use_placeholder_row.description: When true (default), fill an existing empty or <token> placeholder row instead of inserting a new one.

required_revision_id.description: Prefer the short revision_token (r-...) from google_read_document or google_inspect_document_tables; the full revision_id is also accepted. The operation is rejected if the document changed since it was read.

dry_run.description: When true, check preconditions and return the planned status without writing. Default false.

tools.name: google_analyze_document_tables
tools.description: Analyze the table structure of a Google Docs document. Returns tables, rows, text blocks outside tables, and detected date patterns. Use this to inspect a document before appending or repairing table content.

file_id.description: Google Drive file ID of the Google Docs document.

table_selector.description: Optional selector to identify a specific table.

header_cells.description: Ordered list of column header texts to match the table's first row.

tools.name: google_inspect_document_tables
tools.description: Inspect all tables of a Google Docs document cell by cell. Returns revision_token (use it as required_revision_id) and per table a stable table_id, label and section heading, and per cell a stable cell_id, its text and its state (empty, placeholder or filled). Use this before google_update_table_cell. No Docs indices are returned; never compute them yourself.

file_id.description: Google Drive file ID of the Google Docs document.

table_selector.description: Optional filters to identify the table. All given keys must match. The full selector set must resolve to exactly one cell.

table_id.description: Stable table ID from google_inspect_document_tables, e.g. 't.0/2'. Only valid for the revision it was inspected at.

header_cells.description: Complete ordered texts of one table row (usually the header row).

section_heading.description: Section title of the table: the nearest heading above it, the paragraph directly above it, or the text of its first cell.

contains_text.description: Exact text of any cell in the table.

placeholders.description: Extra placeholder texts that count as empty, in addition to the built-in Word placeholders (e.g. 'Klik of tik om een datum in te voeren.') and <token> placeholders.

tools.name: google_update_table_cell
tools.description: Fill one existing cell of a table in a Google Docs document. Select the cell with row_selector + column_selector (row label and column header), or with cell_selector (cell_id from google_inspect_document_tables, or anchor text plus relation). The service resolves the structure and computes all indices. It never adds rows, never overwrites meaningful content unless replace_existing is true, refuses ambiguous selectors, requires the current revision, and verifies the cell after writing. Any status other than 'updated' means nothing was written unless the result says written: true.

file_id.description: Google Drive file ID of the Google Docs document.

table_selector.description: Optional filters to identify the table. All given keys must match. The full selector set must resolve to exactly one cell.

table_id.description: Stable table ID from google_inspect_document_tables, e.g. 't.0/2'. Only valid for the revision it was inspected at.

header_cells.description: Complete ordered texts of one table row (usually the header row).

section_heading.description: Section title of the table: the nearest heading above it, the paragraph directly above it, or the text of its first cell.

contains_text.description: Exact text of any cell in the table.

row_selector.description: Selects the row. Use with column_selector.

cell_text.description: Exact label of the row (case-insensitive, whitespace and trailing colon ignored), e.g. 'Opstartgesprek'.

column_index.description: Zero-based column that holds the row label. Default 0.

row_index.description: Zero-based row index from google_inspect_document_tables. Requires a table_selector.

column_selector.description: Selects the column within the selected row.

header_text.description: Column header text, e.g. 'Datum'. Searched in the rows above the target row, nearest first.

header_row_index.description: Optional zero-based row index that holds the column headers.

index.description: Zero-based column index. When combined with header_text, both must agree.

cell_selector.description: Alternative to row_selector + column_selector, e.g. for tables without column headers.

cell_id.description: Stable cell ID from google_inspect_document_tables, e.g. 't.0/2/1/1'. Only valid for the inspected revision.

anchor_text.description: Exact text of a label cell, e.g. 'Doelstellingen'. Must occur exactly once in the selected tables.

relation.description: Target cell relative to the anchor: 'right' (same row), 'below' (same column, next row) or 'next' (right, otherwise first cell of the next row). Default 'next'.

value.description: Text to write into the cell, verbatim.

required_revision_id.description: Required. Pass the short revision_token (r-...) from google_inspect_document_tables, google_read_document or the previous update; the full revision_id is also accepted but long IDs are easily mis-copied. The call is rejected when the document changed.

replace_existing.description: Allow overwriting a cell with meaningful content. Default false; empty cells and placeholders are always fillable.

dry_run.description: When true, resolve and check everything and return the selected cell, its current content and the planned value without writing. Default false.

placeholders.description: Extra placeholder texts that count as empty, in addition to the built-in Word placeholders (e.g. 'Klik of tik om een datum in te voeren.') and <token> placeholders.

root_folder_id.label: Google Drive project folder ID or URL
root_folder_id.description: Agents can manage files and subfolders in this folder only. Sharing and permissions remain human-only.
